programmes.d: This week Yvette Fielding takes her Most Haunted team to Coalville and a house that is surrounded by mystery. The team seem to disturb the rest of some of its long-term residence as they battle through a night of terror.
Once an old foundry, this large old building houses vehicles from a bygone era that are said to still contain passengers whose destination has never ended.
Yvette heads to Presteigne, Mid Wales and the famous Judges Lodgings, were courts were held, people imprisoned and Judges stayed, but it also holds many a secret.
Most Haunted continues its investigation into the Judges Lodgings where the team seem to be under attack and something is trying to get through a door…but what?

The team venture into a cottage where it is said ‘no living soul can endure living there’. With cursed dolls, murder and suicide this derelict place has everything to fear, and the team were not disappointed.

We stay with the team and find out what happened after we left them last time. The foreboding Codnor Castle Cottage maintains its attack on the Most Haunted team with dramatic effect causing Yvette calls an early end to their night in Hell House.
Yvette takes her team to a disused prison in Birmingham which has housed some of the most notorious criminals in British history.

The ruins that make up Dudley Castle house a plethora of paranormal activity for Yvette and her team to investigate. Strange noises and a violent poltergeist await them as they turn the lights out and do battle with the unseen forces that resided there.
Workhouses were not the best of places to be, so why would anyone stay after they had died? Yvette takes her team on a memorable journey to find out.
Whatever was making itself known to the team earlier, continues in this episode as something seems to be following Yvette from the shadows.
Yvette takes the Most Haunted team into the very haunted, disused attic at the top of this huge country mansion and are soon made to feel very unwelcome.

programmes.d: After a homeowner discovers arrowheads in his yard, his life unravels and his children's lives are threatened; a man captures video of a wheelchair moving on its own.
Visitors tape a chair flipped on its side. A woman's home becomes haunted after her husband dies. A woman and her son hear gunshots at the Gettysburg battlefield.
A haunted honky tonk bar in Kentucky has a terrifying past, including murder, suicide, and even a beheading.
In a place where the homeless were kept and work was hard, death was often the only escape but it seems that wasn’t the way for some as their souls are said to roam this place.
A small prison in Yorkshire gives a big impact when Yvette and her team attempt to stay the night. Although many inmates were released some are still locked up and they are not happy.

Yvette Fielding and her team take on a three-part investigation that tests them to the very core. A place that surprised intrigued and terrified the hardened team, making Standon Hall the most fearful place they have investigated.

Part two of this mammoth investigation and Yvette has some harsh words for Karl as he decides to take a risk that proves too dangerous. With something that wants them out, the investigation gets aggressive.
The concluding part of the team’s most scary investigation to date, but will they last the night as something definitely wants them out.
The team take on one of the grandest properties in Great Britain, Liverpool’s Croxteth Hall in a non-stop two-hour heart pounding investigation.

We stay with the team and find out what happened after we left them last time. The team seem to be stalked by something…but what. Only time will tell what awaits them in the upper corridors of this once grand mansion.
